slug: 2024-04-23 Tunisia to Get Biometric IDs in H1 of 2025

facts.fact: ID Tech reports that adoption of biometric ID cards was made possible through approval of Organic Law No. 22 of 2024, which ranks above ordinary statutes, with rollout targeted for H1 2025; the document gives no promulgation date.
facts.system: Organic Law No. 22 of 2024 on the biometric identity card
